name: HPE Aruba Networking
evidence_summary: HPE positions EdgeConnect SD-WAN as secure SD-WAN and foundation for single-vendor SASE; docs cover orchestrator, appliances and advanced security.
cost_model: Quote-based subscription/appliance/support; MSP-managed options available through partners/providers.
key_differentiators: EdgeConnect SD-WAN (acquired with Silver Peak) is positioned as the foundation for single-vendor SASE alongside Aruba SSE.
Strong heritage in WAN optimisation and packet-level performance engineering.
Tight integration with the broader Aruba campus and branch portfolio (LAN, Wi-Fi, NAC) for buyers consolidating end-to-end networking.
best_fit_for: Enterprises already running Aruba LAN/Wi-Fi who want WAN and SASE under the same operational tooling.
Buyers prioritising application performance and WAN optimisation in addition to standard SD-WAN routing.
Distributed organisations with branch-heavy footprints where Aruba campus presence is already established.
watch_outs: Aruba SSE is newer than the SSE leaders (Zscaler, Netskope); buyers wanting best-of-breed SASE should evaluate the SSE capability set carefully.
Managed delivery is partner-led rather than from HPE directly.
Private global backbone is not vendor-owned; SASE transport uses public cloud gateways.
verification_notes: Re-verified 2026-07-29 against named primary sources. Every graded fact carries a source, a tier and a verbatim quote confirmed present on the cited page by an independent check. Facts that could not be sourced are published as unknown with the reason stated. Sources found and rejected are listed in the evidence register at tier 4.

ai_capability.note: Mist AI and Marvis virtual assistant (HPE Juniper); Aruba Central AIOps with EdgeConnect.

resilience.note: EdgeConnect HA, tunnel bonding and orchestrated failover.

profile.platform_architecture: HPE Aruba Networking's SD-WAN is EdgeConnect (from Silver Peak): physical and virtual appliances with WAN optimisation heritage, tunnel bonding, dynamic path conditioning and sub-second failover. Aruba Central provides cloud management with AIOps across WAN, wired and wireless, and Orchestrator handles advanced WAN policy. Cloud on-ramps cover the major hyperscalers. Following the Juniper acquisition, HPE now fields both EdgeConnect and Mist-based WAN portfolios.
profile.security_sase: Aruba's SASE combines EdgeConnect SD-WAN with HPE Aruba Networking SSE (from the Axis Security acquisition): ZTNA, SWG, CASB and DLP delivered from a global edge. EdgeConnect also integrates tightly with third-party SSE including Zscaler and Netskope, a genuine strength for dual-vendor SASE designs. On-appliance security covers zone-based firewalling and segmentation with IDS/IPS.
profile.service_support_channel: Strong UK channel through HPE partners and MSPs, with managed EdgeConnect offers from carriers and integrators. HPE support runs 24x7 with professional services for migration, and co-managed models are common. Aruba Central's multi-tenant design supports MSP delivery well.
profile.commercials_verdict: Subscription licensing by bandwidth tier and appliance class, quote based, with SSE per user. The Netify verdict: shortlist HPE Aruba when link quality is poor or variable (the path conditioning heritage still leads), when you want first-class freedom to pair best-of-breed SSE, or when an Aruba campus estate makes Central the natural console. Clarify the EdgeConnect and Mist roadmap question directly with HPE during selection.

vendor_faqs.q: Is EdgeConnect still strong on degraded links?
vendor_faqs.a: Yes. Forward error correction, packet order correction and tunnel bonding from the Silver Peak heritage remain differentiators, keeping voice and video usable on lossy broadband or LTE where simpler SD-WANs degrade.

vendor_faqs.q: Can EdgeConnect pair with Zscaler or Netskope instead of Aruba SSE?
vendor_faqs.a: Yes, and the integrations are first class: automated tunnel orchestration into third-party SSE clouds is a supported, documented pattern. That makes EdgeConnect a safe network layer for dual-vendor SASE.

vendor_faqs.q: How does the Juniper acquisition affect Aruba EdgeConnect buyers?
vendor_faqs.a: HPE operates both portfolios today, with consolidation expected over time. Existing EdgeConnect deployments continue to be sold and supported; ask HPE for written roadmap commitments as part of any large procurement.

shortlist_summary: HPE Aruba Networking offer EdgeConnect SD-WAN (brought in with the Silver Peak acquisition) as the foundation for single-vendor SASE alongside Aruba SSE, with a strong branch networking heritage and deployment speed of days that's competitive for a platform of this capability breadth. Typically shortlisted by businesses already in the HPE ecosystem or those looking for a single-vendor SASE story built on an established SD-WAN platform.
cost_note: Subscription by bandwidth tier; mid-market pricing with strong link-quality value on poor circuits.
uk_basis: No UK HQ (US). EdgeConnect delivered in the UK via HPE partners and MSPs.

f01_fully_managed_service.quote: Services that monitor, operate, and optimize your infrastructure and applications, delivered consistently and globally to give you unified control and let you focus on innovation.
f01_fully_managed_service.note: HPE Managed Services is presented as a run-it-for-me operate model covering monitoring, operations and administration. The evidence is corporate HPE Managed Services wording rather than a SASE or SD-WAN specific managed offer, and no end-to-end change and reporting scope for EdgeConnect or SSE was found on the pages reviewed, so confidence is medium.

f03_co_managed_service.quote: HPE Managed Services take care of routine maintenance but leave you in control of innovation.
f03_co_managed_service.note: Shared responsibility is stated explicitly at corporate level. No networking-specific co-managed RACI or customer change-rights matrix was found on the HPE Aruba Networking pages reviewed.

f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.quote: Managing multiple tenants can be useful when you are an MSSP and you manage several separate clients, or otherwise your company has several organizational units it prefers to keep separate.
f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.note: Tenant isolation and cross-tenant admin roles are documented for HPE Networking SSE, and the same documentation page states this is a limited release feature. No evidence of branded or white-label portals, custom logos or reseller templates was found on the documentation or partner programme pages reviewed, so graded partial rather than yes.

f05_professional_services_and_migration_.quote: Take advantage of our networking expertise through your entire journey from initial planning, design, and deployment to ongoing operations and optimization.
f05_professional_services_and_migration_.note: HPE Aruba Networking Services covers planning, design and deployment, and packaged or custom QuickStart services are named. Explicit migration runbooks, rollback plans and pilot or staging stages were not found on the pages reviewed, so the full definition is only partly evidenced and confidence is medium.

f07_lifecycle_management.quote: Advanced hardware replacement options ranging from next business day to 4-hour replacements are available
f07_lifecycle_management.note: Hardware replacement and software updates, upgrades and security patches are stated as part of the support offering. No explicit end-of-life planning or renewal management wording was found on the pages reviewed.

f17_cellular_and_5g_support.quote: SD-WAN works across any IP-based transport such as broadband internet, LTE, 5G, or MPLS.
f17_cellular_and_5g_support.note: The same HPE page also states that EdgeConnect SD-Branch has onboard LTE support. No SIM management or signal monitoring detail was found; the EdgeConnect SD-WAN product page itself contains no mention of LTE, 5G or cellular, so confidence is medium.

f19_public_cloud_gateways.quote: The HPE Aruba Networking SSE service utilizes both onramps and Points of Presence (PoPs) to enhance connectivity.
f19_public_cloud_gateways.note: The PoPs are documented as part of the HPE Aruba Networking SSE service itself, which is HPE's own security service edge infrastructure following the Axis Security acquisition, so this is the vendor's own service infrastructure rather than a resold third party gateway. Several PoP locations carry hyperscaler region names such as Northern Virginia, Oregon and Iowa, which suggests hosting inside public cloud regions, but the service and enforcement layer are HPE's.

f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The HPE Networking SSE Points of Presence documentation lists shared regional PoPs only and contains no mention of private, dedicated, customer-hosted or sovereign PoPs, and the architecture page describes only Atmos Connector, Portal and Cloud components. Absence of a statement is not treated as evidence of absence.

f21_private_global_backbone.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The word backbone is not present on the EdgeConnect SD-WAN product page, the What is SD-WAN page, the SSE Points of Presence page or the SSE architecture page. No claim of vendor-owned or vendor-controlled inter-region transport was located, so this is recorded as unknown rather than no.

f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.quote: Advanced hardware replacement options ranging from next business day to 4-hour replacements are available
f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.note: Contractual support response and hardware replacement commitments are published, and prioritised case handling with expedited initial response time is named. No availability percentage, latency, jitter or loss commitment and no service credit regime were found on any page reviewed, including the HPE GreenLake page, so graded partial.

f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.quote: Leverage a built-in next-generation firewall with IDS/IPS and adaptive DDoS protection to replace branch firewalls.
f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.note: The firewall is described as built into the EdgeConnect SD-WAN platform rather than as a separate appliance, and the EdgeConnect product page repeats a built-in next-generation firewall providing IDS/IPS. Note that the same SASE page separately offers Juniper SRX Series Firewalls as a distinct product line, and URL filtering and malware inspection are delivered through the SSE secure web gateway rather than the SD-WAN firewall itself.

f33_data_loss_prevention.quote: The File Security Profile is a key Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Security feature, controlling the transport of session file data by allowing approved data, blocking risky data or directing suspicious data to be scanned further.
f33_data_loss_prevention.note: DLP is native to HPE Networking SSE with data matchers, allow, block and scan verdicts applied through policy rules. The HPE SASE page also states that security is enforced through integrated ZTNA, SWG, CASB and DLP services. Alerting and formal exception workflows were not separately evidenced.

f40_managed_service_assurance.quote: HPE Aruba Networking's technical assistance centers provide AI-driven 24x7x365 support
f40_managed_service_assurance.note: 24x7x365 technical assistance centres and proactive and preventive features with customer success management are published. No named 24/7 NOC or SOC, no root cause analysis ownership commitment and no structured service review or change governance wording were found on the pages reviewed, so graded partial rather than yes.

delivery_model.quote: HPE Managed Services offloads the heavy lifting of running modern IT, when and where you need it.
delivery_model.note: HPE authors its own products, EdgeConnect SD-WAN gateways, HPE Aruba Networking Central and HPE Networking SSE, and separately operates HPE Managed Services. It also recruits partners to deliver managed networking, so the technology vendor role is primary and the managed provider role is delivered both directly and through the Partner Ready Vantage Managed Services Center of Expertise.

underlay_ownership.quote: SD-WAN works across any IP-based transport such as broadband internet, LTE, 5G, or MPLS.
underlay_ownership.note: HPE positions EdgeConnect as a transport-agnostic overlay that rides whatever IP transport the customer already has. No page reviewed offers HPE-owned circuits, HPE-resold access or an HPE-operated core routing network, and no backbone claim appears anywhere in the material read. Graded customer_supplied_only on that basis, with medium confidence because absence of a circuit-resale statement is not proof that no such offer exists through HPE Networking partners.

regulatory_documentation.quote: How the EdgeConnect SD-WAN Platform Supports PCI DSS Compliance
regulatory_documentation.note: Named framework documentation found: PCI DSS (dedicated HPE collateral) and GDPR plus CCPA (dedicated HPE collateral titled 'GDPR and CCPA compliance: Ensuring data protection with SD-WAN and SASE'). A HIPAA collateral was listed in the page link set but was not fetched, so it is not claimed. Not found on any page reviewed: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, DORA, NHS DSPT. The HPE trust centre host did not resolve from this session, so certification attestations could not be checked there. Confidence is medium because the graded evidence is collateral titles and descriptions rather than an attestation register.

pop_count.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The HPE Networking SSE documentation page dedicated to Points of Presence lists individual locations grouped by region (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America) but publishes no total figure, and the terms points of presence and PoP do not appear at all on the HPE Aruba Networking SSE marketing page. Counting the listed entries would be my arithmetic rather than a published claim, so the value is recorded as unknown.

sla_availability_pct.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. No availability percentage appears on the HPE Tech Care page, the HPE Aruba Networking Support Services page or the HPE GreenLake page, and the HPE GreenLake service level agreements URL returned 404. Support commitments are expressed as response and hardware replacement windows (next business day to 4-hour) rather than an uptime percentage, so the availability figure is unknown.
